title: Toronto & Niagara Falls 2 Days Tour
includes: One night hotel--One booking for one hotel room
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Travelers easily reserve attraction/excursion tickets with the tour guide on the bus.
cancellation:
If you cancel at least 6 full day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a full refund.
If you cancel between 2 and 6 day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a 50% refund.
If you cancel within 2 day(s) of the scheduled departure, you will receive a 0% refund.
blurb: Within two days travelers can visit the most popular and beautiful attractions in Canada. You can experience the vibrant city of Toronto and the soothing nature of Niagara Falls. You will be assisted by our tour leader throughout the trip, you will be able to participate in various activities, and unwind at a nice accommodation.
